responsibility: Primary class and interface declaration header for BRIG code-section translation. It declares the abstract `brig_code_entry_handler` base, reusable unary/binary vector-element visitors, fp16/flush visitors, and the full set of specialized directive and instruction handler classes used to lower BRIG code entries into GCC GENERIC, along with the shared helper APIs they invoke for operand decoding, address formation, conversions, and statement emission.
same_name_distinction: Declares the handler class hierarchy and visitor interfaces for BRIG code entries, while the companion brig-code-entry-handler.cc provides the common lowering logic and helper method implementations those declared handlers use.
